advanced.why: krige_at_w1 was prompt-given: the prompt called it the exactness check and the tile's unit string printed "W1 is 0.3150", so W1's logged porosity passed without kriging anything. It is replaced by a measured per-block kriging output, the porosity jump across the fault on the y = 2200 row (block 0 node at x 1600 minus block 1 node at x 1550, signed), read from the Population explorer's "Jump across the fault on this row" tile at 6 dp: -0.023016035393453593. tol 5e-5: the nearest variogram options (nugget 0.00025 with range 300, 8.8e-5 away; range 600, 1.9e-4) and the trend and constant seams (-0.0210, -0.0287) all fail. The prompt now states the variogram. krige_probe keeps its key; a probe readout with x and y inputs (default 2000, 2300) now prints it at 6 dp, and the lead tightens its tol 0.001 -> 0.0002.
